0.18.1 trimmed to its own changes (approved by the maintainer 2026-11-18, relayed by the coordinator): kept lines are word for word. Client: What's new; Too-many-requests; lock screen covers dialogs (android). Admin: Account; payout paid date; leaving asks first; stale terms or fund changes refused; own suspend or close refused; no transfer reference; second tab; Too-many-requests; role wording. This was the one-time correction before the freeze; the lock rows for client and admin 0.18.1 changed with it.

Client 0.17.0 gained 'Early exits. A SIP the team closes early shows Closed early, and your receipts and statements list it as an early exit.' Checked in v0.17.0: the SipSchedulesSection badge 'Closed early on <date>', Receipts section 'Early exits', StatementEarlyExits on web, and statementPage.ts for the browser statement. Its lock row changed.

Client 0.16.2 gets NO LLP line: migration 071 only renames published documents whose address is exactly the seed's old name, the v0.16.2 frontend has no company-name string, and no record shows the production result (071 pre-check not recorded; DEC-37 says production carries real contacts). If the maintainer's pre-check shows will_change true in production, the line would be: 'The legal pages name the company BeOnEdge LLP.' Adding it needs a deliberate lock change.
No entry: 0.16.1 (test-only 6e97a25), 0.17.1 (Node 24 plus a punycode contracts fix, DEC-57), 0.18.2 (chunk split); no admin 0.16.2 entry (the Tailscale console is infrastructure).

Sources: 0.16.0 = git log v0.15.4..v0.16.0 and plan section 6 A1 to B8 plus the section 8 Phase A to H closes; 0.16.2 = d74e10a (DEC-38); 0.17.0 = plan 'Phase I close' and the v0.17.0 tree; 0.18.0 = v0.17.1..v0.18.0 and plan 'UI overhaul stage A'; 0.18.1 = review.md section 6 (v0.18.0..v0.18.1 commits); 0.18.3 = the six lane briefs, emu-test-0182.md section 2 and DEC-72.

Docs follow-up (rule 18, outside my files): WORKFLOW.md release step 1 should say the new entry's rows go into frontend_stack_ts/src/features/whats-new/releasedNotes.json before cutting. status.sh pushes the VERSION-only release commit and CI runs npm test on main, so a missed row turns CI red on the tagged commit; the failing test prints the rows to add.

Freeze guard releasedNotes.test.ts: per audience, ids strictly descending X.Y.Z; every lock row's entry exists and the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) matches; every entry at or below the root VERSION (../VERSION, read at test time) is in the lock. Entries above VERSION (0.18.3 now) stay editable. Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) gives the same digests. The test assumes cwd frontend_stack_ts (CI and container both use it).

DEC-73 pin (34f2cce): on the shipped notes, last seen 0.18.1 gives ['0.18.3'] and no record gives the explicit release lists (client 0.18.3, 0.18.1, 0.18.0, 0.17.0, 0.16.2, 0.16.0; admin the same without 0.16.2). Update it when 0.18.4 ships.

Prompt tests use a history fixture with no 0.18.2: no record shows all releases, newest open, older collapsed, Done marks the newest; seen 0.18.1 shows only 0.18.3; an unknown id shows only the newest. unseenEntries is unchanged.

Red controls (TESTED): 20261118T065857Z-3556234 edited a released client line; 20261118T065920Z-3569648 removed admin 0.16.0; 20261118T065934Z-3573802 VERSION 0.18.3 without rows; 20261118T065946Z-3577341 unseen keeps the seen entry; 20261118T065952Z-3579996 no record shows the newest only; 20261118T070001Z-3582199 unknown id shows all; 20261118T071543Z-3886210 a client 0.18.2 entry fails the DEC-73 pin. Each one restored and checked with cmp.

Green on clean 34f2cce (Node 24 container): frontend npm ci and check, 59 files / 521 tests, boot check 61 chunks, phonepe check, 20261118T071552Z-3890380; build:client (72 assets, 985127 bytes), build:admin, build:android, build:android:admin with the android-dist, boot and phonepe checks, 20261118T071727Z-3918867. Earlier, on e6c46f9: contracts 20261118T070026Z-3590259, frontend 20261118T070055Z-3596272 (517 tests), builds 20261118T070340Z-3645499.

Rule 11: the seen key boe.<scope>.whatsNew.<userId> and its version-string value are unchanged, so devices that saw 0.18.1 get only 0.18.3, devices with no key (production) get everything, and unknown ids get the newest. No API, contract, schema or storage change; month is optional and ignored by older bundles.

UI: one collapsible block per version, a heading-wrapped button (h3 in the sheet, h2 on pages; aria-expanded, aria-controls, hidden panel), using the datalist DISCLOSURE_* recipes with min-h-target 44 px. A single unseen release still shows its notes directly. Not run in a browser or on a device (rule 3); jsdom only.

Emulator steps (coordinator), client Profile > What's new: the App version card, then one card listing Version 0.18.3 down to 0.16.0, each with 'November 2026'. 0.18.3 is open and the others closed with a plus glyph; tapping one opens it. Heading rows are at least 44 px at 412 px. Android-only lines show; web-only lines do not.

Full history: clear the key with localStorage.removeItem('boe.client.whatsNew.<userId>') in WebView devtools, or clear app data, then sign in or reload. Expect the sheet 'What's new' described 'Versions 0.16.0 to 0.18.3', 0.18.3 open, older versions collapsed, and the sheet scrolling. Done closes it; after a reload there is no sheet, and the stored value is '0.18.3'.

Dev tester: localStorage.setItem('boe.client.whatsNew.<userId>', '0.18.1') and reload. Expect the description 'Version 0.18.3 · November 2026', only the 0.18.3 notes, and no version headings. Repeat both on the admin APK with boe.admin.whatsNew.<userId> and Account > What's new (five versions; no admin 0.16.2).
